summary_md: **ModelScope ([@ModelScope2022](https://x.com/ModelScope2022/status/2115709539735806456))** announces **Nanbeige4.3-33B GGUF** on ModelScope, a 33B dense Apache-2.0 model aimed at coding, tool use and multi-step agent work, with a 512K-token base context and Q4_K_M through Q8_0 quantizations plus llama.cpp and Ollama setup notes ([ModelScope model page](https://modelscope.ai/models/Solstice-AI/Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF-UltraOptimised-Curated-Protium)).
relevance: A ~30B-class agent-oriented model with local quants, right in the DGX Spark sweet spot.
